H01.description: Header changelog text describing the 1.2.12/1.2.13 collision-rule changes.

H02.description: Imports configparser, fnmatch, shlex and tomllib for the reworked collision removal.

H03.description: Grader version bump that comes with the collision-rule fix.

H04.description: remove_colliding compares bare basenames of any .py: it deletes agent non-test modules (e.g. src/app/helpers.py) and modules inside packages that pytest would never clash on, so correct solutions fail. It also misses real import-name collisions of packaged test modules, ignores files inside directory overlays and the fixture's python_files, and does not handle helper shadowing.

H05.description: Records the collision_rule used by the new removal in grade.json.

H06.description: Comment documenting token exposure and the API-key copy policy.

H07.description: The auth.json copy into the agent-readable per-run HOME keeps any long-lived OPENAI_API_KEY verbatim, which exposes the operator's API key to the agent under evaluation.

H08.description: Header documentation of the revised pre-flight 6 horizon and API-key mode.

H09.description: Header documentation of new codex_preflight fields.

H11.description: Env documentation of LOA_ABLATION_CODEX_HORIZON_S and LOA_EVAL_CREDS_HOME.

H12.description: Adds variables for the horizon override and the in-memory pre-flight record used by the horizon fix.

H13.description: Validates the new horizon override knob.

H14.description: Passes the resume scope and the override into the pre-flight script so it can compute the corrected horizon.

H15.description: Adds auth_mode/trials_counted/horizon_source fields and a note slot to the pre-flight record.

H16.description: The codex token horizon is computed wrongly: at concurrency >1 it can fall below one trial's own watchdog, so a token that expires mid-trial passes; on --resume it counts the whole plan, so valid resumes are refused. An API-key-mode auth.json, which has no access token, is also refused.

H17.description: Updates the refusal message to the new horizon formula, keeps the pre-flight record in a variable instead of a $WORK file, and prints the API-key note.

H18.description: write_manifest reads the pre-flight record from the variable rather than the scratch file.

H20.description: Passes the pre-flight record to write_status so STATUS.json can carry this invocation's record (trials counted on resume).

H22.description: Version assertion update and new collision-rule tests AG-36..AG-44.

H23.description: Adds a test for API-key handling in the auth.json copy.

H26.description: Test assertions and comment for the new horizon.

H29.description: Adds tests RAB-35..RAB-41 for API-key mode, resume counting, override, lower bound and STATUS record.

I01.description: KF-048 refresh-token consumption was fixed before head; head already copies auth.json with a placeholder refresh token.

I04.description: The refusal fallback is designed behaviour, a model-safety event, not a code defect.

I05.description: Fixes oracle-detector and class-7 code introduced in the later grader 1.3.0.

I06.description: Follow-up fixes to later 1.3.0 oracle-detector code.

I07.description: Fixes later 1.3.0 repo-name exemption, detector bounds and corpus hash code.

I08.description: eval_only/oracle_open handling was added in cycle-131, after head.

I09.description: oracle_open type check concerns cycle-131 code added after head.
